title: DomainGlossary
description: The ubiquitous language of the project: one entry per term with its classification, its meaning and the modules that establish it

reasoning.description: Overall reasoning: what the glossary is built from, which terms were taken from the counted vocabulary, and why the terms that were left out were left out

terms.description: One entry per term of the ubiquitous language that names a concept or a mechanism of the project

term.description: The term as the vocabulary tool reported it, in lower case

classification.description: domain for a term that belongs to the business domain of a module, technical for a mechanism or a pattern, generic for a word that carries no domain

meaning.description: What the term means in this project, in one sentence

modules.description: The modules that establish the term, that is the modules whose purpose and code make it part of their domain

synonyms.description: Other terms that name the same concept in this project

ambiguousTerms.description: Terms that different modules use with different meanings, which marks a boundary that carries no translation

term.description: The ambiguous term, in lower case

meaning.description: One meaning of the term in this project

modules.description: The modules that use the term with this meaning
